intro: A glass of air mangga from a stall has about 200 kcal (estimate). Most of it comes from added sugar syrup, not just the mango.

variants.name: Air mangga, large size (big plastic cup)

diet: Yes, especially if you ask for kurang manis. Mango itself has vitamins, but stalls often add a lot of syrup. A normal glass once in a while is still okay. If you want something more filling with fewer calories, cut mango helps more.
tips: Ask for 'no sugar' or 'kurang manis'. Ripe mango is already sweet enough.
Skip the condensed milk or ice cream.
Pick a small size, or share a big cup with your partner.

swap.name: Air mangga, no added sugar
swap.why: The mango taste is still strong, but the added sugar is gone and the calories drop by more than half.

faq.q: Do stalls use real mango for air mangga?
faq.a: Many stalls use fresh mango, but some use mango paste or flavoured syrup. You can ask the seller.

faq.q: Which mango is best for juice?
faq.a: Harumanis and chokanan are popular because they're sweet and fragrant, so you don't need much sugar.

faq.q: Can I make air mangga at home?
faq.a: Yes. Blend ripe mango with ice and water. No need to add sugar if the mango is already sweet.
